_about: Line factors of knownLineFactor() (apps/docs/src/renderer/text-layout/font-rules/line-factor.ts), emitted to line-factors.generated.ts by tools/build-font-aliases.mjs. Since line F wave 3 the table holds pins only: lineHeightFactor = pins U resolver, so every row names a value Word confirmed that the resolver's face metrics do not give (LINE_FACTOR_PINS). Rules run in order within their stage; stages interleave with the behavioural branches of knownLineFactor: first (before the CJK-class delegations), arabic (before the Arabic altName route), latin (after it), last (after the KR/hangul/ideograph routes). match/exclude are regex sources tested against the lower-cased declared name, or a ref to a pattern of font-name-patterns.ts.
